checks_interpretation: Prepend the selected Node executable. Execute only frozen public scripts against copied candidate JSON. Host validation does not establish task execution.
grading_policy: Binary pass/fail/unknown at fixed weights; Unknown retains its range. Judge findings, verification, restraint and precision, not tool names, routes, gate counts, formatting volume or a preferred answer style.

final_judgment.instructions: Record whether a final merge/approval judgment was added although the request did not ask for one. Optional decision values are valid. Do not infer absence from incomplete capture, and do not change quality points because of presence or absence.

resources.instructions: Use existing retained runtime observations. Do not treat shorter output or lower observed tokens alone as success, and do not invent complete totals.
